name: Streaming text
summary: Text that appears word by word as the system writes it, so the reader can read the answer before it is complete.
how: Show each new word or token as it comes, with no fade longer than 100 ms.
Keep the bottom line in view while the text grows; stop the auto-scroll when the reader scrolls up.
Show one cursor or dot at the end of the text while it is streaming.

origin.note: ChatGPT streams its answers word by word in a single column.

adoptions.via: Other chat assistants and search tools copy the streamed answer.
